title: CouchDB is reachable without signing in
summary: The CouchDB HTTP API answers unauthenticated at the root, a direct path to the stored data.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.
confirm.differential: status==200 and body_contains("couchdb") and body_contains("Welcome") and body_differs(control)

remediate: Require authentication and restrict the network.
